title: PvP Coliseum
items: **PvP works** (Quests, then PVP). You fight opponents generated by the server: avatars with random parts, among the ones you own, and random medals taken from the current Shop pulls. Builds are weak at first and get stronger as your class grows.
**Weekly seasons** change on Monday morning, game time, and rotate through the seasons whose required Keyblades you already own. No Keyblades are given.
**Class and rewards follow your wins** (class 1 to 8). The weekly reward arrives in the Present Box when the week changes, and the point-threshold rewards (300, 500 and so on) arrive at once.
**Fixed along the way:** the Result screen now shows a win as a win.

title: Union Cross: 1060 of 1106 stages
items: **From 292 to 1060 playable stages.** Events now run up to 2021 with their maps. Stages that share a map work like in the game, and 12 Daybreak Town rooms were added.
**The banner and the stage match.** A different event comes up each time you open the app, and the world and boss of the stage match the banner on the 70 banners where we could tell.
**14 stages were rebuilt** for eight 2019-2020 events from rooms of known stages with the boss swapped. They are not the original maps. 46 stages are still out.
Fixed a crash in the November 2020 event: the client lacked the models of 10 NPCs.

title: Colosseum PvE complete
items: **All 73 seasons are playable** (53 before). The 16 seasons with missing maps were recreated from the wiki enemy lists: same enemies and waves, positions inferred from real maps.
The missing enemies were added (Pumpkin Soldier, Cheery Ape, Darkball, Morning Star, Ice Plant and more) and the July 2021 season too.
A different season comes up each time you open the app, and your progress is kept for each one. The quest screen now shows 1st for the Colosseum.

title: Medals, raids and fixes
items: **Seven-star medals that were unobtainable** now drop from Gacha banners close to their release date (37 medals: Stained Glass, KH III SN, Flans, MoM, Key Arts and others). With 3 of the 9 SN++ Illus. KH III medals you get 1 SN++ Strelitzia with 99 Trait Medal #256 in the Present Box, a pair for every 3. The 7 Moogle and Mushroom medals with no source arrive in the Present Box after quest 525.
**Progress** on Special, Events and Union Cross now shows the percentage of quests cleared instead of staying at 0.
**Outfit** in Customize no longer crashes the app. The Raid Boss missions now count. Raid boss weak points now have their own HP and take damage from all-attack medals too.
**Moogle Shop:** two new Jewel offers in the Items tab, 10,000 Jewels for 20,000 munny (after quest 250) and 30,000 Jewels for 50,000 munny (after quest 500).
**Spirit Training:** all four slots are always open. **Colosseum Rewards** no longer freezes the game and marks the tiers you have completed.

title: Medal voices and gifts
items: **107 medal voices** play on the medal card and in Gacha results (not in battle), covering 151 medal names.
Album, avatar parts, gifts at quest thresholds, the banners of January and February 2021, 49 VIP banners open to everyone and one free deal a day per banner.

title: VIP events and the Album
items: **78 VIP challenge events** in the Events tab, several rebuilt from the wiki.
Avatar Coins at every level up, farming of evolution materials, Key Art #2 as a gift, a permanent Album, and Cross, Avatar and Coliseum board images redone from the wiki.

title: Tutorial and first launch
items: Fixed a crash when re-entering the game halfway through the tutorial.
The tutorial Gacha now shows its two banners, and the High or Low resolution choice appears after mission 6, as in the original.

title: The first working version
items: **A server on the tablet.** It started as a script on the device and ended up inside the Android app, so a tablet can play without a PC.
Union Cross solo play (292 stages), the first Colosseum season, boards, titles, party, Moogle Shop and the first set of Gacha banners.
